Tested locally on Windows + C# with the MRP from https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/122930 (rebased on top of `master` https://github.com/godotengine/godot/commit/6220ead4fa06611918e371e6f51d7b9a3aefe53c), this resolves the on-export issue (no more errors printed while exporting the project).

However, there's still an error being printed when running the exported project:

```
Godot Engine v4.8.dev.mono.custom_build.74e99170e (2026-09-01 18:22:36 UTC) - https://godotengine.org
D3D12 12_0 - Forward+ - Using Device #0: NVIDIA - NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5090

ERROR: Failed to instantiate an autoload, script 'res://NETAutoload.cs' does not inherit from 'Node'.
   at: (main\main.cpp:4506)
GDScript ready
```
